behavior.provisioning: Writes owner-only approval.json beside the independently generated issuer material; binding digest is fixed in issuer.key.
behavior.verifier: Supervisor supplies the store path; no receipt-selected binding or path, no signing method returned.
behavior.perOperation: Re-read private approval; compare to the opening snapshot; reuse issuer material, revocation and envelope checks.
behavior.legacy: Missing approval is rejected without reconstructing or provisioning from evidence.

limitations: Private host store assumes a trusted same-uid supervisor and must remain outside reader mounts.
Verifier authenticates only the existing three-pair pilot receipt.
No accepted policy document registry, conformance/full-matrix bundle, operational promotion importer or real-computation qualification is established.
Existing native receipts predate this change; no new native workflow run is claimed.
